description: 한국토지주택공사_임대주택단지 피크전력 절감 시뮬레이션 서비스 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국토지주택공사. 한국토지주택공사에서 관리하는 임대주택단지를 대상으로 피크전력 절감에 따른 에너지 사용량 및 관련 정보를 시뮬레이션 할 수 있는 서비스입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국토지주택공사. Its tags are 토목, 건축, 스마트홈, 에너지정책, 에너지사용량. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
